scope: Bisect post-operation submodule availability and guarded callback

native.coverage: Real eight-commit fixture adds .gitmodules at the initial revision and removes it at step four. Start restores configuration at a candidate; classification removes it again; Reset restores the configuration-free tip. Each result checks file presence against model availability. Successful configured progress invokes the injected callback; busy, load-only and unsuccessful progress cannot invoke it. Prior Bisect, Export, Log integration and focused Rebase native fixtures pass.
native.limitations: Configuration presence tested, not submodule contents/update execution. Hidden owned windows; callback and stash replies injected. Activated dialog handoff, displayed alert interaction, Finder activation, screenshots, keyboard/accessibility and signed sandbox not exercised.

verification.audits: Both bundle validators and exact NOTICE comparisons passed; Store --require-git; 90 original icons and universal helper runtimes verified.
verification.process_audit: No main app, Finder menu receiver or native receiver remained

remaining: Log Bisect entry points, cancellation, activated Finder/dialog handoffs and signed App Store acceptance remain incomplete. Full port remains incomplete.
